description: This file implements the AdbConfigFragment class for handling ADB configuration serialization and deserialization within the Cuttlefish project. It defines the AdbConfigFragmentImpl class, which serializes ADB modes and connector status to JSON and parses JSON to set configuration options. It also provides a component registration function for dependency injection.

classes.name: AdbConfigFragmentImpl
classes.description: Implementation of the AdbConfigFragment interface, providing JSON serialization/deserialization of ADB configuration.

methods.name: Name
methods.description: Returns the name of the fragment implementation.

methods.name: Serialize
methods.description: Serializes the ADB configuration to a JSON object.

methods.name: Deserialize
methods.description: Parses a JSON object to set the ADB configuration.
